sections.Profile:
The Texan pinball machine, manufactured by D. Gottlieb & Co. in April 1960, was designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1960
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Western, Wood Rail, Original Theme, Cowboys
